title: docs(ci-cd-pipeline): pin lint.yml's step list, and make the Lint section true
body:
Fixes #8015

## The centre of the card is the pin's scope

`scripts/__tests__/ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts` already held exactly the right rule — *every
first-party command a job runs must be named where this page documents that job, and the
documentation may not credit it with one the job does not run* — and it was scoped to **`ci.yml`
alone**. `lint.yml` was covered only by the workflow-INVENTORY pin, which requires a `##` heading
naming the file and asserts nothing about the heading's contents. So its step list could drift
indefinitely underneath a green test file.

That gap was **demonstrated** rather than argued: on the neighbouring card (#8006), a sentence in
this same document was replaced with an obvious falsehood and the eleven test files that read the
page were re-run — 404/404 green, `check-doc-links` exit 0. Nothing looked at this page's contents
beyond the `ci.yml` table.

## Re-derived on today's tree, not reused from the card

The card measured `28cfff4` and listed three undescribed commands. On `4b4d35a7d` there are
**four** — `check-bash32-floor.mjs` landed in `lint.yml` at `4922b83fc` (#8016) after the card was
written, which is the drift rate this pin exists to absorb.

Parsed with the same rule the pin uses (`run:` values only, never the surrounding YAML):

| | commands |
|---|---|
| `lint` job **runs** (7) | `scripts/check-lint-coverage.mjs`, `scripts/check-entry-guard.mjs`, `scripts/check-upstream-port-parity.mjs`, `scripts/check-bash32-floor.mjs`, `pnpm lint`, `scripts/check-cross-repo-closer-outcome.mjs`, `pnpm check` |
| page **named**, before (3) | `scripts/check-lint-coverage.mjs`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm check` |
| **missing** (4) | `scripts/check-entry-guard.mjs`, `scripts/check-upstream-port-parity.mjs`, `scripts/check-bash32-floor.mjs`, `scripts/check-cross-repo-closer-outcome.mjs` |
| **phantom** (0) | — |

**Positive control for the parser**, so the four is a reading and not a broken matcher: the same
matcher run over the same section found the three commands the page *did* name, and found 12 `run:`
steps in the job of which the environment ones (`corepack enable`, `pnpm --version`, `pnpm install
--frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/cli...' build`, the inline `should_run` shell block)
correctly drop out by naming nothing this repository owns. A matcher that saw nothing would have
reported the page's three as missing too.

## How the pin generalises (rather than being copied)

`jobKeys`, `jobBlock`, `runSteps`, `firstPartyCommands`, `undocumentedCommands` and
`phantomCommands` move to **module scope**, together with the rule's docblock. The new entry point
is:

```ts
commandParity(workflowFile, jobKey, documentation, label?)
```

The two sources differ only in *where* the prose lives — one table cell per job for `ci.yml`, one
whole `##` section for `lint.yml`'s single job — so that is the only thing a caller supplies. The
`ci.yml` block keeps its own history and its own failure messages and is now three lines long; the
new `lint.yml` block is the same shape.

Reading the *whole* Lint section rather than only its bullet list is deliberate: the paragraphs
below the bullets discuss `pnpm lint` and `pnpm check` too, and a rule that read only the list would
call those phantoms.

A companion assertion pins that **`lint.yml` still defines exactly one job**, so a second job cannot
arrive undocumented and unpinned at the same time.

## Ablation — both directions, on the committed tree

Each leg mutates a **committed** file, proves the mutation reached disk *before* any result is read
(on-disk `git hash-object` differs from the HEAD blob, plus a marker count), and restores by
**state** (`git diff HEAD` empty), never by exit code. The script carries a `trap … EXIT INT TERM`
with absolute paths.

```

      Tests  49 passed (49)

  on-disk hash = 69a872dc3b4ac4ef3848238adf8de5c230519813 (HEAD 405826570dd7c3ea05aa4672877d544e0895e21c)
  marker "ABLATION-A" count = 1 (expected 1)

  vitest exit = 1

content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md does not name:
  - lint.yml `lint`: scripts/check-doc-links.mjs
  RESTORED (git diff HEAD is empty)

===== LEG B: the page names a command the lint job does not run =====
  marker count before = 0

  marker "ABLATION-B" count = 1 (expected 1)
  LANDED
  vitest exit = 1

commands that .github/workflows/lint.yml does not run:
  - lint.yml `lint`: scripts/check-doc-links.mjs
  RESTORED (git diff HEAD is empty)
```

## Commands run (real output)

All vitest runs went through the shared verify lock.

```
$ pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  49 passed (49)
os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0

$ pnpm exec vitest run <the 16 test files that read this document>
 Test Files  16 passed (16)
      Tests  489 passed (489)
os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0

$ pnpm type-check:scripts                        → exit 0
$ node scripts/check-doc-links.mjs               → exit 0  "Links are valid across 17 scan roots."
$ node scripts/check-control-bytes.mjs           → exit 0  "scanned 6662 tracked text file(s)"
$ node scripts/check-doc-fence-languages.mjs     → exit 0
$ node scripts/check-shell-escape-residue.mjs    → exit 0
$ node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test <both changed paths>
    ✅ NOT GOVERNED — 2 path(s) checked against 5 governed surface(s); none matched.
```

**Changeset — measured, not guessed:**

```
$ node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs
Compared the working tree with 4b4d35a7d (merge-base with origin/main): 2 file(s) changed,
0 of them published source of a package the release covers, 0 of them a manifest whose published
contract moved, 0 under a package changesets ignores, 0 changeset(s) added.
✅  No source or published contract of a released package changed in this range, so no changeset is owed.
```

So no changeset, and no `skip-changeset` label — this page's own pins deny that label is wired to
anything here.

**ESLint, narrowed with the narrowing proven** (`pnpm lint` is `turbo run lint`, which walks
packages; `scripts/` has no `package.json`, so the changed file is outside that surface — it was
linted directly anyway):

- population read from eslint's own config, not guessed: `eslint.config.js` declares no
  `parserOptions.project` and no `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and no verdict on
  an untouched file can move because of this diff;
- file count read from `--format json`: **1 file linted, 0 errors, 0 warnings**;
- the other changed file is `.md`, outside `files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}']` entirely.

Control-byte self-scan beyond the gate: `grep -naP '[\x00-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f\x7f]'` over both
changed files → no matches.

## Out of scope, filed not fixed

**#8420** — every other workflow section on this page is unpinned the same way, with two verified
instances (`vi-mock-specifiers.yml`'s section omits the blocking `check-vi-mock-inherit.mjs`;
`shadcn-check.yml`'s omits all three of its commands). Deliberately **not** a rider here: a naive
whole-page extension flags 24 of 34 sections, most of them cross-referencing prose rather than
defects, and this document is under concurrent edit today.

Not touched, as the card directs: the Skill Guide Paths sentence (#8006, landed) and the
`main@6422aa891` baseline sentence (#7965 ruled it correct, since it declares its measurement
point).
